name: services/users/employment_positions
description: Get information on employment positions of a given user. Only the current positions will be returned.
brief_description: Get information on employment positions of a given user.

arguments.name: include_past
arguments.description: By default past employments are  omnited. To disable this behaviout setset parameter to true. Note that only administrative consumersare allowed to do this.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • position - Employee's position.

    This field references objects returned by position method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

  • faculty - A dictionary with the id and name (LangDict) of the faculty..
errors: • object_not_found - some of the referenced objects do not exist; param_name is equal to user_id.

result_fields.name: faculty
result_fields.description: A dictionary with the id and name (LangDict) of the faculty.
